name: frame-flicker
prompt: Old film flicker as a shader layer: brightness should jump randomly once per frame (not smoothly), with some dust specks that change every frame.

provenance.via: claude --print with the in-app agent instructions (no Powermove MCP tools)

summary: I wrote an old-film flicker shader that uses iFrame, so brightness and dust (up to 32 specks, mostly dark) re-randomise every frame with no smoothing between frames. Scratches and grain also change each frame, over a sepia base with a vignette; controls are uFlicker, uDust, uDustSize, uScratches, uGrain, uVignette and uTint. It hasn't been compiled or rendered because no Powermove tools were available in this run.
